text.tspan: * Central State University (CSU), in Ohio, has been designated as an 1890 LGU. Under the law,
CSU will be eligible to receive certain capaciity funds in October 2014 and others in fiscal year 2016.
** College of the Muscogee Nation and Keweenaw Bay Objibwa Community College are designated
as 1994 LUGs and will be eligible to receive capacity funds in October 2014.
